tldr: Lilith in the 7th house: the untamed in partnership
body: Lilith in the 7th house: the untamed in partnership. Where you reclaim honesty and power in close bonds instead of performing the role. Watch: provocation and power struggles. You refuse to disappear inside a partnership; relationship is where the disowned self gets triggered and reclaimed. Idealized expectations projected onto partners, with disappointment when they prove human. Attracts independent, rebellious partners, and relationship crises tend to be the catalyst for real healing.
business: Demands an equal who does not try to own you.
shadow: Power struggles, or attracting the controlling dynamic you fear.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
